content: Multilingual RAG Test Document NovaTech Solutions — Annual Business Summary 2025 Company Overview NovaTech Solutions is a fictional technology company providing cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity, and data analytics services. In 2025, the company expanded into three new markets and increased investment in artificial intelligence. Financial Performance NovaTech Solutions reported revenue of $150 million in 2025, compared with $120 million in 2024. Net profit increased from $18 million in 2024 to $25 million in 2025. The company attributed the revenue growth mainly to cloud services and cybersecurity products. Regional Performance North America generated $70 million in 2025 revenue.
